## About The Program

The **Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship Program 2026-27**, an initiative by **Tata Capital Limited**, aims to support the higher education of meritorious students from economically weaker sections of society. The name **'Pankh'**, which means **'wings'** in Hindi, symbolises the program's belief that financial constraints should never limit the aspirations of talented young minds.

Under this program, students currently studying in **Classes 11 or 12, as well as those pursuing undergraduate degrees, diplomas, or ITI courses** at recognised institutions across India, are eligible for financial assistance.

Launched as part of **Tata Capital Limited's Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)** initiative, the scholarship seeks to eliminate financial barriers that hinder deserving students from pursuing their educational goals. By empowering students with access to quality education, the program contributes to nurturing a more educated, skilled, and self-reliant generation.

* ##### Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship for Class 11th and 12th Students (2026-27)

  ###### EligibilityDeadline Date: 26-Oct-2026

  + Open to **Indian students** currently enrolled in **Classes 11 or 12** at a recognised educational institution in **India**.
  + Applicants must have secured at least **60% marks** in the preceding academic year.
  + Annual parental income from all sources must not exceed **INR 4 lakh**.
  + Must be studying at a recognised board/institution in India.
  + Children of employees of **Tata Capital** **Limited** and **Buddy4Study** are not eligible to apply.

  ***Note:***

  *Preference will be given to girl students, Persons with Disabilities (PwD), single-parent households (due to death or divorce), orphaned students, and those from affirmative-action backgrounds (SC/ST).*

  Read more..

  **Benefits:** 

  Selected students will receive scholarship benefits as mentioned below:

  + Students scoring **60% to 80% marks** will receive **up to 80% of tuition/course** **fees** or **INR 10,000**, whichever is less.
  + Students scoring above **80% and up to 90% marks** will receive **up to 90% of tuition/course fees** or **INR 12,000**, whichever is less.
  + Students scoring above **90% marks** will receive **up to 100% of tuition/course fees** or **INR 15,000**, whichever is less.

  ***Note:** The actual reimbursement amount for each candidate will be confirmed and shared after selection.*

  View DetailsApply Now

#### FAQ’s

The selection of scholars follows a structured multi-stage process based on academic merit and financial background:

* Initial shortlisting of applicants based on academic performance and financial eligibility
* Verification of submitted documents
* Telephonic interview of shortlisted candidates following document verification
* Final confirmation by Tata Capital Limited
